independentReview.method: Generated five fresh paired contact sheets directly from all 40 installed WebPs. Each pair displays original color with source alpha and black RGB with the same alpha on a light background. Actually viewed every sheet, all four installed corrections full-size, and the near-edge helicopter and pear full-size. Computed SHA-256 and raw pixel alpha bounds for each installed asset. Read current integrated bank questions, answers and aliases; all match previous drafts except two harmless question improvements.
overallFindings: All 40 installed subjects match their general Arabic answer classes with the installed context clues.
All 40 visible alpha>=16 outlines have positive margins and no measured edge contact. All four corrected assets are resolved.
Ten old files contain tiny canvas-edge alpha traces of only 1–4/255; do not describe every edge pixel as exactly transparent. These were not visible object clipping in the inspected composites.
Pear and helicopter have narrow but positive visible margins; full-size inspection confirms complete outline. No regeneration recommended on current evidence.
The installed ginger question contains the necessary scent/flavor clue, resolving the earlier context-free ambiguity concern.
No new material subject/anatomy defect is identified. Real game-renderer reveal, device readability and accessibility must be covered by the root review.
